in_hebrew.name: Daliborka
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Daliborka הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Slavic elements dal- (given) and borka (bright, renowned), Daliborka means 'God's gift' or 'God's renowned one'.

in_greek.name: Daliborka
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει God's gift
in_greek.long_meaning: Daliborka είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Slavic elements dal- (given) and borka (bright, renowned), Daliborka means 'God's gift' or 'God's renowned one'.

in_latin.name: Daliborka
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat God's gift
in_latin.long_meaning: Daliborka est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Slavic elements dal- (given) and borka (bright, renowned), Daliborka means 'God's gift' or 'God's renowned one'.
